raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "kramdown-parser-gfm" %}
{% set version = "1.1.0" %}

package:
  name: rb-{{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://rubygems.org/downloads/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.gem
  sha256: fb39745516427d2988543bf01fc4cf0ab1149476382393e0e9c48592f6581729

build:
  noarch: generic
  number: 1
  script:
    - gem install --norc -l -V --ignore-dependencies {{ name }}-{{ version }}.gem
    - gem unpack {{ name }}-{{ version }}.gem

requirements:
  host:
    - ruby
  run:
    - {{ pin_compatible('ruby', max_pin='x.x') }}
    - rb-kramdown >=2.0,<3

test:
  commands:
    - ruby -r {{ name }} -e 'exit 0'

about:
  home: https://rubygems.org/gems/kramdown-parser-gfm
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: kramdown-parser-gfm provides a kramdown parser for the GFM dialect of Markdown

  doc_url: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/kramdown-parser-gfm
  dev_url: https://github.com/kramdown/parser-gfm

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jdmarques
    - sodre
